name: "Stitch Girl"
source:
If damaged stuffed animals can be fixed by sewing, why not me?

This game has a main theme of self-injury (body-stitching) to embroider one's own body, so some texts and illustrations have grotesque depictions.
translation:
如果损坏的毛绒玩具可以通过缝纫来修复，为什么我不可以呢？

该游戏以自伤（缝身）为自己的身体进行刺绣为主题，因此部分文字和插图有怪诞的描绘。
